title: In a six-week drought, my allotment plot is wet every single dawn.
description:
An old man gave me the key to his allotment plot and said it was time for somebody new. That spring it didn't rain for six weeks, and every plot on the hill cracked in the sun. Except mine. Mine was dark and wet at every dawn.

Then a head came up out of the soil by the gate, and each morning it was one bed further down the path, nearer to my beans.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: What's one thing somebody taught you that you'd pass on?
